g.title: Public webhook endpoint — signature verified inside the handler
Verify Slack signature, deduplicate, invoke Master Agent. Provisioned concurrency keeps cold starts under the webhook deadline.
Private endpoint — agent authenticates with IAM, authorized via EKS Access Entry (read-only).
Orchestrator — fans out to specialized agents, enforces deadlines, synthesizes the incident report.
VPC-attached — reaches the cluster's private endpoint
